dataIdInfo.idAbs: This layer shows four existing facility types: shared use paths, bike lanes, separated bike lanes and bicycle/pedestrian priority roadways. The inventory is primarily from MassDOT's 2020 dataset and includes all state-owned infrastructure as well as facilities under local jurisdiction. Linework has been adjusted in some places to be more accurate based on DCR Trails, Open Street Map, and MassGIS 2021 Orthoimagery.
dataIdInfo.idCredit: Massachusetts Department of Transportation Office of Transportation Planning, Department of Conservation and Recreation, Open Street Map, MassGIS
